dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Emit a diagnostic (or fail explicitly) in the classify job when HEAD^ never resolves after the deepen loop, so an unexpectedly-deep parent that forces the full route is observable rather than silent.
evidence: gerrit-verify.yaml:136-139: `for depth in 1 8 32; do git rev-parse --verify -q 'HEAD^' ... && break; git fetch --deepen="$depth" || true; done`
scripts/classify_gerrit_verify_change.py:92-112 `changed_paths` returns None when `git diff HEAD^ HEAD` fails (unresolved parent), which classify_repository maps to FULL
dropped.finding: The classifier's HEAD^ deepen loop caps at cumulative depth 1+8+32=41 commits; if the patchset parent is deeper than that in the mirror-first shallow checkout, `git rev-parse HEAD^` still fails, `changed_paths` returns None, and the classifier emits `full`. This is fail-safe (routes to full Verify), but the loop silently swallows fetch errors (`|| true`) and never surfaces that the parent was never resolved, so an unexpectedly-deep docs-only change silently loses the reduced-lane benefit with no diagnostic.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a structural test asserting the vote CONCLUSION full-route conjunction enumerates exactly the full-route jobs in vote.needs, so the two cannot drift.
evidence: gerrit-verify.yaml:481-491 enumerates build-and-test/mutation/optionality/artifact-probe/eval-discipline/golden-path/verify-identity as `== 'success'` for the full route
The set is duplicated relative to `vote.needs` at gerrit-verify.yaml:432 and the full-route job list; nothing asserts the two stay in sync
dropped.finding: The vote-normalization CONCLUSION expression enumerates every full-route job by name and requires each to be exactly 'success' for the full route to be trusted. When a future full-route job is added to the `needs` list (or renamed) but not added to this enumerated conjunction, the aggregate would still evaluate the route as complete without that job's result, and the new job's failure would only be caught by the separate FAILURE_OBSERVED signal — a fragile invariant with no structural guard tying the enumeration to vote.needs.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm that classifying only HEAD^..HEAD cannot let an unmerged stacked-parent commit's code changes reach the docs-only executed tree without full Verify (or document why Gerrit's per-commit submit model makes the parent independently gated).
evidence: scripts/classify_gerrit_verify_change.py:100-105 diff args are `"diff","--name-only","-z","--no-renames","HEAD^","HEAD"` — only the topmost commit relative to its immediate parent

gerrit-verify.yaml:169-174 the docs-only job checks out the full Gerrit change ref via checkout-gerrit-change-action, then gerrit-verify.yaml:205-208 runs ./.github/actions/docs-gates with run-contract-tests=true

action.yml:154-158 the contract-test selector runs `git grep ... -- "tests/**/*.py"` over the whole checked-out tree and then executes the selected tests, so any code present in an unclassified parent commit is exercised/relied-on but not gated by the full matrix
The classifier docstring at scripts/classify_gerrit_verify_change.py:5-7 asserts it classifies 'HEAD^..HEAD path set', confirming only the top commit's changes gate the route decision
dropped.finding: The docs-only route classifier bases its trust decision on the single-commit diff HEAD^..HEAD, but the docs-only job checks out and executes against the entire patchset ref (pytest, pre-commit, and scripts run over the full working tree). For a stacked/relation-chain change whose parent commit (HEAD^) is not already on main and carries code/test/config changes, those changes fall outside the classified HEAD^..HEAD path set yet are present in the executed tree — a scope mismatch between what is classified and what is executed/verified.
scenarios: A relation chain where the parent commit modifies src/ or scripts/ and the child (HEAD) touches only docs/: the child patchset classifies docs-only and skips build-and-test/mutation/optionality, while the parent's code changes ride along unverified in the executed tree
